Install

Graph signal processing extends classical signal processing concepts to data defined on graphs. The spectral graph wavelet transform (SGWT) provides a way to analyze signals across graph scales using the graph Laplacian spectrum.

sgwt implements:

  • Construction of graph Laplacians

  • Spectral kernels for wavelets and scaling functions

  • Discrete wavelet operators

  • Numerical routines for experimentation and research

The package emphasizes clarity, numerical stability, and interoperability with SciPy sparse linear algebra.
